title: The Lighthouse Keeper's Last Broadcast
author: The Mosaicast Authors
subtitle: Forty years of weather logs, and one entry that shouldn't exist.
description:
On the final night before the light goes automated, the keeper reads out forty years of weather logs — and one entry that was never supposed to be recorded.

We talk maritime superstition, the economics of solitude, and why a foghorn is basically a very sad synthesizer. Full sources on the show notes page.

title: Coffee, Comets, and Other Disasters
author: The Mosaicast Authors
subtitle: Near-misses, both cosmic and caffeinated.
description: A history of near-misses: the espresso machine that predicted an earthquake, and the comet everyone forgot to name.

title: A Brief History of Getting Lost
author: The Mosaicast Authors
subtitle: Maps, mazes, and "you are here".
description: Maps, mazes, and the surprisingly recent invention of "you are here".
